summary: Full end-to-end testing of the new match/توصيل question type. Backend: 8/8 pytest tests passed (bank listing with pairs, create-quiz-from-bank with only match, hidden pairs/correct_answer in student payload, partial-credit scoring, all-correct full credit, pairs_result enrichment on result endpoint, mcq regression). Frontend: student exam MatchingQuestion component renders 2 columns with 4 lefts/4 rights, click-to-connect draws SVG connecting lines with distinct colors per pair, re-assignment of a left correctly frees the previously connected right, progress counter 'X/Y إجابة' does NOT count a match question until ALL pairs are connected, submit works. Student result page renders pair-by-pair breakdown (left → student_right) color-coded, with '(لم يربط)' for empty and 'الربط الصحيح' block listing correct mappings; NO raw JSON. Teacher QuizResults detail modal shows the same per-pair breakdown color-coded with correct mappings; NO raw JSON. QuizEditor 'الأسئلة' tab shows purple 'توصيل' badge and hides the pencil/edit icon for match questions (only trash icon shown). Regression MCQ create-from-bank still works.

issues: Console warning: 'Cannot update a component while rendering a different component' — likely caused by MatchingQuestion.useLayoutEffect calling setLines() which triggers parent re-render; consider guarding with a JSON.stringify comparison of lines before setLines to avoid noisy warning (functional behavior is unaffected).

action_items: (Optional/minor) Suppress the React setState-during-render warning in MatchingQuestion.jsx by memoizing/comparing lines before calling setLines inside useLayoutEffect (functional impact: none).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py already large (~2400 lines) - question bank + gradebook + quiz all live in server.py; consider splitting into routers (not blocking).

get_questions() for match randomly shuffles 'right' at every fetch — student refreshing during exam sees a different right-order each time which could confuse UX (right list is not persisted with the submission). Consider persisting shuffled order alongside question_order per submission.

submit() scoring uses str(student_map.get(str(i),'')).strip() equality — case-sensitive and exact whitespace; acceptable since values come from the fixed right[] list, but no normalization if pair text has trailing whitespace variations.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted a temp quiz (id 7fd62984-...) from grade-7 seeded match question. No lingering test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Match feature confirmed working end-to-end. Note: seed match questions in DB have grade values '5','6','7','8' (numeric) while other endpoints/UI often use 'الخامس','السادس' — worth reconciling if the QB grade filter appears to show 0 match questions for grade 5 UI in the future. In current tests QB stats bar correctly showed '13 توصيل' for grade 5, so filtering seems to work via meta endpoint.
